(2) The same paragraph already gives F1's 0.73 to 1.26 ratios and table 4.6 prints F1's counts (50,227 to 50,893 and 84,080) beside run 3's (108,075 to 109,528), so the reader has the F1 numbers. (3) No primary source says F1 contradicts the hypothesis. Jesse's F1 README, CME rows (line 206) says of these same counts "which level served the rest, these counts do not show", and line 190 says that with the L3 on the CME's refills at 8 KiB come almost all from inside the cluster (0.00 to 0.02 per load from outside against run 3's 1.65 to 3.43), so lower home-node counts on F1 are consistent with the L3 serving refills, prefetches included, inside the cluster. The page's own closing sentence, "no run has counted the mesh around a CME command with the split events on", correctly states that the hypothesis is untested on either run.
